proposed_widenings.name: portal_creation_and_lifecycle
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is creating a persistent, traversable, two-way portal that remains in play until a creature takes a later Magic action to close it. Existing effects like teleport, block_travel, or anchored_trigger do not represent a created portal object with open/close lifecycle.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence" and "The portal remains open until a creature within 5 feet of it takes a Magic action to close it"

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.cooldown_timed_random
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is reusable after a random elapsed-time cooldown, not on a rest, dawn, or never. Current activation resource reset cadences cannot express 'can't do so again for 1d8 hours.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for 1d8 hours."

notes: Destination selection is GM-decided and caller-owned, but that is not the blocking issue. The deterministic core still requires a real portal/open-close model plus a timed random cooldown, so no honest content/*.dhall was authored.
